axes.concept: An operational register: compare the complete contents of each access plan, without a sales hierarchy.
axes.layout: Four horizontal plan rows in one shared panel; plan/price, available tools and unavailable tools form three desktop columns. Each row stacks on phones.
axes.navigation: A local four-plan anchor index focuses the chosen plan heading; a contextual return link leads to the access screen or the originating account surface. The existing account disclosure adds one Plans link.
axes.typography: Existing locally embedded Geist and Geist Mono; 24px page title/prices, 19px plan names, 14px tools and 12px availability labels. Phone prices are 21px.
axes.density: One divided register rather than four promotional cards; all cumulative tools are repeated explicitly. Compact row groups expose both price and availability without expanders.
axes.components: Real shadcn/Base UI Button and Input, real Skeleton, existing SP-2 native account disclosure, inline lucide checks and semantic lists. The comparison row is a custom composition, not an invented library component.
axes.colour: Pictures semantic tokens unchanged in light and dark; neutral shell/rows, muted unavailable-tool text, existing accent only for links, focus and existing primary controls.
axes.motion: Precise registration: 12px horizontal row settlement at 240ms in Expressive, 35ms row offsets, and rule expansion from .65 to 1 over 360ms. Index underlines use 150ms transforms. Reduced motion/still shows the final state immediately; hidden tabs suspend CSS motion.
